title: aura.helplines — the crisis helpline directory (PRD 06c F9, 18 'Helplines by country')
description: The content of a `helplines` signed bundle and of the bundled baseline (helplines.v1.json). Every implementation (apps/mobile/tool/gen_helplines.py, the app's compileHelplines, NestJS helplines/document.ts) enforces exactly these rules plus the three this schema cannot say: (1) every line id starts with its country code in lower case, and ids are unique across the document; (2) the digits of `number` are exactly `dial` (what is shown is what is dialled); (3) every country of the bundled baseline (IN, US) is present. Unknown keys are allowed and ignored (review notes, later additions).

verifiedOn.description: When the numbers were last checked by a person.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region (the device region, never IP or GPS) → its lines, in the order the app lists them. A region that is not here gets the generic 'call your local emergency number' card, never an empty list.

id.description: <country in lower case>.<snake_case>; stable, never reused for another line (analytics `crisis_helpline_tapped.helpline`).

dial.description: Digits for tel:; must equal the digits of `number`.

audience.description: `minors`: listed only until the 18th birthday (and behind the under-13 lock).

names.description: Name per app locale; a locale without one shows `en`.

vector.description: An entry of the signed payload's `vectors`: what the resolver must list for a region. NestJS writes one per country × {adult, minor} plus the unlisted region ZZ (empty); the app refuses a bundle whose vectors its own resolver doesn't reproduce.
